title: Re-Blasted
description: Changes Heatblast's appearance in the “Gravestone: Herotime” to one that more closely resembles Heatblast's appearance in Omniverse
body:
Here is the “Re-Blasted” resource pack. It gives the Heatblast a new look, making it more similar to the one from Omniverse.

**(And so it changes not only the texture of the Heatblast itself, but also the icons for its abilities and the textures of those abilities themselves)**

### Join the mod creator's Discord server to see more Herotime-related content:
### **[Gravestone: Herotime Discord](https://discord.com/invite/jk5u6T5gbD)**
